name: Castildelgado (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a blue diagonal band fimbriated yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castildelgado (a castle and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Castildelgado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly
